devdoc.details: The permanent owner is the staged governance Executor supplied at     construction. Root-class roles are granted and revoked only by the     Executor; operational-class roles are also grantable     by registered role managers. The vocabulary is closed-world: grants     against constants outside the pinned [GOV-ROLES] table revert. Holder     sets are enumerable so redundancy gates and deployment checks can prove     the active authority graph from state reads alone.

RoleMutationCommitted(uint16,bytes32,add.details: `roleChainHash` is scoped to `role`; `globalChainHash` commits to      every grant/revoke across the registry. Both counters are      monotonic, so a holder set that returns A -> B -> A remains      distinguishable from the original A state.

emergencyRecipient().details: Never a stored raw address (ADR 0004 [GOV-ROLES]; ADR 0013 decision U5).

grantScopedRole(bytes32,bytes32,address).details: Keeps the vocabulary closed at the base level while supporting the     additive per-scope designation of ADR 0004 [GOV-WINDOWS] (for     example per-scope terminal-freeze veto guardians). Authority follows     the base role's grant class. Reverts `UnknownRole` when `baseRole`     is not scopable.

isRoleRedundant(bytes32).details: Necessary but not sufficient. This gate cannot establish that the     holders are independently controlled; that remains a ceremony/     off-chain obligation ([GOV-MATERIAL]; [LTA-GUARDIAN] rule 8). A     `true` result is a floor, not a proof of redundancy.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

registerRoleManager(address,bool).details: Enablement is delayed class 1. Disabling an existing manager is      immediate tightening class 0 and uses the account-scoped config      chain so the manager cannot censor its own removal.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

roleManagerConfigMutationState(address).details: This chain is deliberately independent from operational-role and      global audit mutations so a compromised manager cannot stale its      own root-initiated removal.

roleRedundancy(bytes32).details: The contract-holder count is a necessary-but-insufficient onchain     proxy for redundancy: it cannot prove the holders are independently     controlled. The exact EIP-7702 designation is rejected on grant and     excluded if observed later, while true independent control remains a     ceremony/off-chain governance obligation ([GOV-MATERIAL];     [LTA-GUARDIAN] rule 8).

AmbiguousRoleResolution(bytes32,uint256).notice: Reverts when single-address resolution meets multiple holders.

DisjointRoleConflict(bytes32,bytes32,add.notice: Reverts when a grant would violate a pinned role-disjointness rule         ([GOV-WINDOWS] rule 3: pause guardians cannot unpause and         unpause holders cannot pause).

RoleActorNotAuthorized(bytes32,address).notice: Reverts when the caller may not grant or revoke the role class.

RoleAlreadyGranted(bytes32,address).notice: Reverts when granting a role the holder already has.

RoleGovernanceActionClassMismatch(uint8,.notice: Reverts when an Executor-owned mutation is not delayed class 1.

RoleGovernanceActionIdZero().notice: Reverts when the active Executor context exposes no action id.

RoleGovernanceActionNotExecuting().notice: Reverts when an Executor-owned mutation is not the active         target call of a Governance V2 batch.

RoleGovernanceNewStateHashMismatch(bytes.notice: Reverts when the complete post-mutation role state is not committed.

RoleGovernanceOldStateHashMismatch(bytes.notice: Reverts when the live pre-mutation role state is not committed.

RoleGovernanceScopeHashMismatch(bytes32,.notice: Reverts when the per-call role/config scope is not exact.

RoleHolderIndexOutOfBounds(bytes32,uint2.notice: Reverts when a holder enumeration index is out of bounds.

RoleManagerConfigNoOp(address,bool).notice: Reverts when a RoleManager configuration write changes nothing.

RoleMutationRevisionOverflow(bytes32).notice: Reverts if a role's append-only mutation counter can no longer advance.

RoleNotGranted(bytes32,address).notice: Reverts when revoking a role the holder does not have.

RoleUnresolved(bytes32).notice: Reverts when resolving a role with no current holder.

UnknownRole(bytes32).notice: Reverts when a role constant is outside the pinned [GOV-ROLES] vocabulary.

ZeroRoleHolder(bytes32).notice: Reverts on zero-address holders and role managers.

RoleMutationCommitted(uint16,bytes32,add.notice: Emitted for every successful role-holder mutation.

SCHEMA_VERSION().notice: Schema version carried by role lifecycle events.

globalRoleMutationState().notice: Returns the append-only aggregate of every role grant/revoke.

grantRole(bytes32,address).notice: Grants `role` to `holder` under the role's grant class rules.

grantScopedRole(bytes32,bytes32,address).notice: Grants a per-scope instance of a scopable base role         (`scopedRole(baseRole, scopeHash)`) to `holder`.

hasAnyTerminalFreezeVetoRole(address).notice: Returns true when `account` holds the global terminal-veto role         or any derived per-scope instance of it.

isKnownRole(bytes32).notice: Returns true when `role` is in the pinned [GOV-ROLES] vocabulary.

isRoleManager(address).notice: Returns true when `account` is a registered role manager.

isRoleRedundant(bytes32).notice: Returns true when `role` satisfies the onchain proxy for the         [GOV-WINDOWS] rule 2 emergency-holder floor: at least two         holders, all of which expose deployed code at observation time         and none of which carries the exact EIP-7702 delegation         designation.

isScopableRole(bytes32).notice: Returns true when `baseRole` may be granted per-scope.

registerRoleManager(address,bool).notice: Enables or disables an operational-role manager through the         exact Governance V2 transition committed for `account`.

resolveRole(bytes32).notice: Resolves `role` to its single current holder; reverts when the         role has zero or multiple holders.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).notice: Revokes `role` from `holder` under the role's grant class rules.

revokeScopedRole(bytes32,bytes32,address.notice: Revokes a per-scope instance of a scopable base role from `holder`.

roleGrantClass(bytes32).notice: Returns the pinned grant class for `role`         (1 = root, 2 = operational); reverts for unknown roles.

roleHolderAt(bytes32,uint256).notice: Returns the holder of `role` at `index` (unordered enumeration).

roleHolderCount(bytes32).notice: Returns the number of current holders of `role`.

roleManagerConfigMutationState(address).notice: Returns the manager-address-scoped exact governance chain.

roleMutationState(bytes32).notice: Returns the append-only mutation chain and revision for an         exact role key. The role key may be either a base role or a         derived scoped role returned by `scopedRole`.

roleRedundancy(bytes32).notice: Returns the holder count and the count of non-EIP-7702 holders         with deployed code observed at call time, for [GOV-WINDOWS]         rule 2 redundancy gates.

scopedRole(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Returns the derived per-scope role key         `keccak256(abi.encode(baseRole, scopeHash))`.

scopedRoleMutationState(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Returns the append-only mutation state for a derived scoped role.

supportsInterface(bytes4).notice: ERC-165 identity used by executor-first bootstrap binding.

terminalFreezeVetoMembershipCount(addres.notice: Returns the exact number of global plus scoped terminal-veto         memberships currently held by `account`.

userdoc.notice: Admin registry resolving the ADR 0004 [GOV-ROLES] `ROLE_*`         vocabulary to current holders.
